_comment: Auto-generated from mechanic registry. Do not edit manually. Run: npm run generate:mechanics

action-drafting.description: Draft actions/roles from a shared pool each round

action-event.description: Cards serve dual purpose as actions or events

action-points.description: Action economy: points per turn, costs per action type

action-programming.description: Program a sequence of actions to execute

action-queue.description: Players queue actions for sequential execution

action-retrieval.description: Retrieve previously played cards/actions back to hand

action-timer.description: Time-limited actions with budgets per player

advantage-token.description: One-time advantage tokens that can be passed between players

alliances.description: Form and break alliances between players

area-majority-influence.description: Compete for majority control in areas for points

area-movement.description: Movement between named areas with adjacency

auction-once-around.description: Once-around auctions where each player gets one bid opportunity

auction-sealed-bid.description: Sealed bid auctions where all players bid simultaneously and hidden

auction-turn-order-until-pass.description: Bid in turn order; passed players exit

automatic-resource-growth.description: Resources that grow based on current value (interest, regeneration)

betting-and-bluffing.description: Betting rounds with optional bluff calling

card-matching.description: UNO-style card matching with color and value rules

catch-the-leader.description: Balancing mechanic that penalizes leaders/benefits trailers

closed-drafting.description: Simultaneous card selection with passing (7 Wonders style)

command-cards.description: Cards that issue commands to game elements

communication-limits.description: Restricts when and how players can communicate.

contracts.description: Contract fulfillment system for resource trading

cooperative-actions.description: Cooperative play with shared resources and threat tracking

cooperative-game.description: All players cooperate against the game system

critical-hits-and-failures.description: Special outcomes for extreme combat rolls

deck-building.description: Acquire cards into personal deck (Dominion, Star Realms)

deck-construction.description: Pre-game deck building from card pool

dice-rolling.description: Core dice rolling with modifiers and effects.

different-dice-movement.description: Dice determine movement options rather than just distance.

elapsed-real-time-ending.description: Game ends after set number of turns

follow.description: Non-active players may follow the active player's action at reduced strength

freeplay.description: Experimental: Enable parallel play without turn-based alternation

grid-coverage.description: Cover grid spaces to control territory

hand-management.description: Hand size limits and discard policies

hidden-movement.description: Player positions hidden from other players.

hidden-objectives.description: Hidden objectives system for secret win conditions

hidden-roles.description: Assigns secret roles to players, enabling social deduction mechanics.

hidden-victory-points.description: Keeps player scores hidden until end game or specific conditions.

i-cut-you-choose.description: Fair division through cutting and choosing

income.description: Automatic resource generation each turn or round

induction.description: Discover secret rules by testing examples

investment.description: Spend resources now for multiplied future returns

ladder-climbing.description: Beat the previous play or pass (President, Big Two style)

loans.description: Loan/debt system with interest and repayment

map-addition.description: Expand play area with new tiles

matching.description: Find matching pairs among hidden elements

melding-and-splaying.description: Create card melds and splay for bonuses

memory.description: Memory-based mechanics where revealed info is hidden again

modular-board.description: Variable board layout from modular tiles

movement-points.description: Movement economy: points per turn, terrain costs

multi-use-cards.description: Cards with multiple possible uses (Race for the Galaxy, Glory to Rome)

negotiation.description: Binding and non-binding agreements between players.

network-and-route-building.description: Build connections between points to form networks

once-per-game-abilities.description: Special abilities usable once per game

open-drafting.description: Draft cards from a visible display

ownership.description: Claim and manage ownership of game elements

pattern-building.description: Create specific arrangements on personal grids

pattern-recognition.description: Identify matching patterns among visible elements

pick-up-and-deliver.description: Transport goods between locations for rewards

player-elimination.description: Eliminates players when they meet criteria during play

player-judge.description: One player judges submissions from others

point-to-point-movement.description: Movement between nodes connected by routes (Ticket to Ride, Pandemic)

prisoners-dilemma.description: Simultaneous cooperate/defect choices with payoff matrix

questions-and-answers.description: Ask yes/no questions to deduce hidden information

re-rolling-and-locking.description: Yahtzee-style dice: roll, keep some, re-roll others.

role-playing.description: Players adopt character personas with traits and abilities

roles-with-asymmetric-information.description: Different roles have access to different information

roll-spin-and-move.description: Classic board game movement where dice determine spaces moved.

rondel.description: Circular action wheel with distance-based cost

score-and-reset-game.description: Multi-round play with scoring between rounds

semi-cooperative-game.description: Players share collective goal but compete individually

set-collection.description: Collect matching sets of cards for points/effects

storytelling.description: Players tell stories or give creative descriptions, others vote/judge

sudden-death-ending.description: Instant win/lose conditions that end the game immediately

tableau-building.description: Build a personal tableau of cards for ongoing benefits

targeted-clues.description: Give targeted clues about hidden information

team-based-game.description: Fixed team structures where players win/lose together

tech-trees-tech-tracks.description: Research technologies with prerequisites and bonuses

tile-placement.description: Place tiles on a board to build the game map

traitor-game.description: Adds traitor vs loyalist hidden roles with asymmetric win conditions.

tug-of-war.description: Bidirectional marker pushed by opposing forces

turn-order-claim-action.description: Claim turn order positions through actions

turn-order-pass-order.description: Turn order determined by pass order from previous round.

turn-order-progressive.description: Snake draft order that reverses each round.

turn-order-role-order.description: Turn order determined by player roles

turn-order-stat-based.description: Determines turn order based on player statistics.

turn-order-time-track.description: Time track based turn order (furthest back goes next)

variable-player-powers.description: Assign unique powers/abilities to each player

variable-set-up.description: Randomize game setup elements each game

win-elimination.description: Win by being the last player standing

win-end-game-bonuses.description: End-game bonus scoring with configurable criteria

win-finale-ending.description: End-game scoring phase with multiple scoring categories

win-highest-lowest-scoring.description: Win by having the highest or lowest score at game end

win-king-of-the-hill.description: Win by controlling a specific location/area

win-race.description: First to reach the goal wins

win-reach-state.description: Win by reaching a specific board state

win-score-threshold.description: Win by reaching a score threshold

win-single-loser.description: Last player standing loses, everyone else wins

win-timeout.description: Determine winner when max_rounds is reached

win-victory-points-as-resource.description: Victory points tracked as a spendable resource

worker-placement.description: Place workers on action spaces to claim actions, blocking other players

worker-placement-different-worker-types.description: Worker placement with multiple worker types

worker-placement-with-dice-workers.description: Dice serve as workers with face values determining valid placements

zone-of-control.description: Units project control over adjacent spaces

hidden-roles.notes: Basic role assignment works, but role revelation and special win conditions need GM adjudication

traitor-game.notes: Supported via hidden-roles, but traitor mechanics require GM interpretation
